# Open choices: embedded-automotive-industrial

`aidd-team:embedded-automotive-industrial` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rtos` | Which RTOS or SDK runs the firmware on the microcontroller? | Zephyr, at its latest stable release or its LTS release, for a new product. FreeRTOS or the chip vendor's SDK where the chip or the code base already needs it. | Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ESP-IDF, Embassy (Rust), Bare metal on the chip vendor's SDK |
| `misra-checker` | Which checker reports the MISRA C rule violations? | Cppcheck's open-source MISRA addon for the MISRA C:2012 rules it covers. A qualified checker where the safety case needs the edition the pack names in full. | Cppcheck with the MISRA addon, Cppcheck Premium, A qualified commercial checker |
| `emulation` | Where does the firmware run in CI when no board is attached? | Renode, with a model of the board the product uses. QEMU where only QEMU models the chip, and the RTOS's host build for logic that needs no peripheral. | Renode, QEMU, The RTOS's host build (Zephyr's native_sim), The chip vendor's simulator |
| `firmware-update` | Which bootloader checks the signature and version of a new firmware image? | MCUboot, with signed images, downgrade prevention, and a test swap that reverts after a failed boot. The chip vendor's secure boot where MCUboot has no port for the chip. | MCUboot, The chip vendor's secure boot and bootloader |
| `mcu-gui` | Which library draws the user interface on a microcontroller's display? | LVGL, with each screen tested on the host against a reference image. | LVGL, Slint, TouchGFX, Qt for MCUs |
